capabilities: collect unchecked checklist items from Canvas text cards
list collected tasks in a card headed # Входящие as Subject :: task entries
remove an Inbox entry when the source task is checked
check an Inbox entry to complete the matching source task
poll Canvas files every two seconds to detect changes
extras: The Inbox card is identified by the literal Russian heading '# Входящие'; cards whose first heading is not that text are ignored. No manual review by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: keeps an Входящие card in an Obsidian Canvas synchronized with unchecked checklist items
problem: Obsidian Canvas cards have no built-in way to gather scattered unchecked tasks into one reviewable inbox list.
summary: Collects unchecked checklist items from an Obsidian Canvas's text cards into a designated Inbox card and syncs check-off state both ways.
